title: After the restart: verify live that a read-only Claude reviewer runs `engram source --root R --json` (c4c0 in the running build)
outcome: After the restart: verify live that a read-only Claude reviewer runs `engram source --root R --json` (c4c0 in the running build)
acceptance: In the restarted TermAl build that contains c4c0, a read-only Claude review child runs `engram source --root <its review root> --json` through the read-only Bash gate, on a dirty review root, and receives the complete source_id. The run is observed in a real review, for example Comovo's Claude review half, and recorded with the build hash, the session and the command result.

completion.summary: Verified the deployed read-only Claude Bash gate on TermAl 487cb4e4 with Engram 5bcd10b8. The real Comovo Claude review ran the exact source command on a dirty root and received a complete source_id matching the baseline at all recorded boundaries. The separate dirty-worktree probe also passed, and its disposable worktree was removed. Independent evaluation a15a843cfb0e4f19bd0099449c9526a6 passed the unchanged criterion.
